# The census tracts that meet the area, with CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability
# Index 2020: RPL_THEMES is the overall percentile, 0 least and 1 most
# vulnerable; CDC writes -999 where it has no value.
frame = curio_load_data("data.curio.chicago-loop-layers", part="tracts.geojson")
for column in [c for c in frame.columns if c.startswith(("RPL_", "E_"))]:
    frame[column] = frame[column].where(frame[column] != -999)
# Tell the Autark map what kind of layer this is, so it draws it as one.
frame.metadata = {"layerType": "polygons"}
return frame
nodes.goal: Load the census tracts that meet downtown Chicago, with CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability Index 2020.
nodes.title: Census tracts (SVI)

nodes.content:
# Overture Maps' buildings. Autark extrudes a buildings layer by its height
# column, in metres: Overture's height, else 3.5 m a floor, else 10 m.
frame = curio_load_data("data.curio.chicago-loop-layers", part="buildings.parquet")
frame = frame[~frame["is_underground"].fillna(False).astype(bool)]
height = frame["height"].fillna(frame["num_floors"] * 3.5).fillna(10.0)
frame = frame.assign(height=height)[["id", "height", "num_floors", "class", "geometry"]]
frame = frame.reset_index(drop=True)
# Tell the Autark map what kind of layer this is, so it draws it as one.
frame.metadata = {"layerType": "buildings"}
return frame
nodes.goal: Load Overture Maps' buildings of downtown Chicago, with a height for every one.
nodes.title: Buildings

# The CTA 'L' stations; ada is whether the station is accessible.
frame = curio_load_data("data.curio.chicago-loop-layers", part="cta_stations.geojson")
frame["ada"] = frame["ada"].map({True: "accessible", False: "not accessible"}).fillna("unknown")
# Tell the Autark map what kind of layer this is, so it draws it as one.
frame.metadata = {"layerType": "points"}
return frame
